name: -x-border-radius-mode
author: songshourui.null
desc: Selects the resolution of existing border-radius values in Native UI rendering (Fragment Layer Rendering) on Android, iOS, and Harmony. Not inherited. The auto mode preserves the default behavior: width for horizontal percentages and height for vertical percentages. The long-side mode uses max(width, height) for both axes. The short-side mode uses min(width, height) for both axes and independently scales the left and right corner pairs to fit that shorter side, preserving ellipse proportions. All modes then apply CSS overlap reduction. Traditional platform UI rendering does not support this property.

android.notes: Requires Native UI rendering (Fragment Layer Rendering).

ios.notes: Requires Native UI rendering (Fragment Layer Rendering).
